title: Locktober Q&A with Snuffles
description:
For this Q&A, I dragged Snuffles in to talk about all things Locktober.

Snuffles is gorgeous, non-binary, very kinky, and has the useful distinction of actually having worn a chastity cage before, which made them the perfect person to sit down with me and talk through the month from both sides of the dynamic.

We talk about chastity, denial, keyholding, cages, expectations, what makes Locktober so much fun, what can make it difficult, and some of the things people probably don’t think about until they’re already very horny and very locked.

There are questions, stories, opinions, practical advice, and a good amount of giggling.

If you’re doing Locktober this year, thinking about doing it, keyholding for somebody else, or you’re simply curious about why anyone would willingly spend an entire month being denied...

Come listen to us talk about it.
author: Lambellina
